about: Release queue export for /roadmap: number, title, one plain line and planned slot (day, and place in that day at one update an hour). Regenerate from the release plan after any queue change; the server queue is the truth.

updates.title: MCP landing page for people who open the agent address
updates.line: The MCP endpoint now explains itself to people who open it in a browser, with setup steps and the tool list.

updates.title: Health shows the running commit and how fresh each part is
updates.line: Health now reports the running commit and the age of every data feed and job.

updates.title: Contracts page with every address and its verified source
updates.line: New contracts page: every deployed address with explorer and Sourcify links.

updates.title: Public USDG peg reading
updates.line: New public USDG peg reading with its source and age.

updates.title: Rate-limit headers on every answer
updates.line: Every answer now carries RateLimit headers.

updates.title: MCP tool capstan_venues
updates.line: New MCP tool capstan_venues.

updates.title: Security headers on the API host
updates.line: Stricter security headers on the API.

updates.title: Market changes feed
updates.line: New feed of market listings, delistings and reduce-only moves.

updates.title: Per-venue status endpoint
updates.line: New per-venue status: data age, budget headroom, last error class.

updates.title: SDK keeps your agents after a page reload
updates.line: The SDK now restores your agents after a browser reload.

updates.title: Quote table readable on phones
updates.line: Quotes are now readable on phones, one card per venue.

updates.title: Spread scan says why a pair was left out
updates.line: Spread scans now list excluded pairs and the reason, and one odd market no longer holds up the rest.

updates.title: Close-all carries on past one venue and cancels resting orders
updates.line: Close-all now carries on past a venue it cannot read and cancels resting orders before closing.

updates.title: MCP tool capstan_book
updates.line: New MCP tool capstan_book.

updates.title: Content-Security-Policy for the website
updates.line: The website and dashboard now send a strict Content-Security-Policy, and the dashboard is built and tested on every commit.

updates.title: Alert when anchoring falls behind
updates.line: Ops now get an alert when receipt anchoring fails or falls behind, and every anchored hour is recounted.

updates.title: List of posted anchor roots
updates.line: New list of anchored hourly roots with their transactions.

updates.title: Receipts show their anchor
updates.line: Receipts now carry their anchor transaction once posted.

updates.title: Status page shows data age and the peg
updates.line: Status page now shows venue data age and the USDG peg.

updates.title: Public payment rail state
updates.line: New public view of which payment rails are on, and a rail that misses one read now comes back by itself.

updates.title: Request id on every answer
updates.line: Every answer and error now carries a request id.

updates.title: SDK waits politely on rate limits
updates.line: The SDK now retries rate-limited reads after Retry-After.

updates.title: Sitemap and robots for the website
updates.line: The website now has a sitemap and robots file.

updates.title: Builder fee reconciliation metric
updates.line: Fee reconciliation now reports metrics and mismatches.

updates.title: Error catalog
updates.line: New error catalog with a plain explanation for every code.

updates.title: MCP errors explain themselves
updates.line: MCP errors now carry the code and a link to its explanation.

updates.title: Each service gets its own database login
updates.line: Each service now has its own database login with only the access it needs.

updates.title: Quotes use the funding forecast when it is fresh
updates.line: Quotes now use the funding forecast when it is fresh and say which source they used; forecasts say when their data was last seen.

updates.title: Your tier and limits in one call
updates.line: New /v1/limits: your tier, limits and credits.

updates.title: SDK helpers for limits and errors
updates.line: SDK: limits() and errorInfo() helpers.

updates.title: Dashboard shows your tier and limits
updates.line: Dashboard now shows your tier and limits.

updates.title: New locks count within a block
updates.line: Lock tier changes now apply within about one block.

updates.title: Download all your receipts
updates.line: Export all your receipts as one file.

updates.title: SDK saves and checks your receipt export
updates.line: SDK: save your receipts and verify every one offline.

updates.title: Verify page takes a file
updates.line: The verify page now checks a whole receipt file.

updates.title: Lock Whale monthly call credits
updates.line: Lock Whale owners now get $10 of premium-call credits each month.

updates.title: Machine-readable price list
updates.line: New machine-readable price list for paid routes, and every paid route now charges exactly what the list says.

updates.title: MCP resources for the disclaimer, venues and prices
updates.line: MCP now offers the disclaimer, venues and prices as resources.

updates.title: Pricing page reads the live price list
updates.line: Pricing page now reads the live price list.

updates.title: More webhooks for lock tiers
updates.line: Webhooks are now capped at 5, or 20 for lock tiers.

updates.title: Send a test event to your webhook
updates.line: Webhooks can now be tested with one call.

updates.title: MCP rate limit per caller
updates.line: MCP calls are now limited per caller, and each paid tool call runs once per payment.

updates.title: Status page lists anchored roots
updates.line: Status page now lists the last day of anchored roots.

updates.title: Choose your liquidation alert distance
updates.line: Liquidation alerts now take your own distance and watch every position you hold.

updates.title: Webhook delivery log
updates.line: New delivery log for each webhook.

updates.title: Receipt checks in plain words
updates.line: Receipt verification now explains each check and says when a receipt is not anchored yet.

updates.title: Copy-ready samples in the docs
updates.line: Docs now have copy-ready samples for every route.

updates.title: Liquidation heatmap bucket size
updates.line: Heatmap now takes a bucket size and counts each position once.

updates.title: Receipt claims checked against the venue
updates.line: Receipt claims are now checked against the venue's own order record.

updates.title: Onboarding checks every step before you sign
updates.line: Onboarding now checks every step before you sign, and Lighter onboarding includes the eligibility declaration.

updates.title: Burn plans check a reference rate
updates.line: Burn plans now check the pool rate against a 30-minute average and keep demo files apart.

updates.title: Alert when a market you hold goes reduce-only
updates.line: New alert when a market you hold goes reduce-only.

updates.title: Lighter orders build reliably
updates.line: Lighter order builds now use the venue's own next nonce and follow the market review.

updates.title: SDK watch helpers for live channels
updates.line: SDK: live watch helpers for risk, receipts and plans, and each spread plan now runs once.

updates.title: Prometheus alert rules
updates.line: New monitoring alert rules for the service.

updates.title: Each payment unlocks exactly one answer
updates.line: Each payment now unlocks exactly one paid answer.

updates.title: Preview an order without building it
updates.line: Order builds can now be previewed without storing anything.

updates.title: Command line receipt check
updates.line: New command line receipt checker.

updates.title: README: verify a receipt in three commands
updates.line: README now shows how to verify a receipt yourself.

updates.title: Root indexer catches up after downtime
updates.line: The root index now fills gaps after a restart and lists only roots that are final on chain.

updates.title: Each order build is relayed once
updates.line: Each order build is now relayed at most once, and a kill applies up to the moment of sending.

updates.title: SDK checks the contract addresses too
updates.line: SDK now refuses if the API serves different contract addresses.

updates.title: Weekly restore test of the backups
updates.line: Backups are now restore-tested every week.

updates.title: Payment service settles only for Capstan and recovers stuck payments
updates.line: The payment service now settles only Capstan's own payments and recovers payments held up by a network outage.

updates.title: Published eligibility rules
updates.line: Eligibility rules are now published with the age of the location data, and applied the same way at every step.

updates.title: Agent limits count the worst case
updates.line: Agent limits now count the largest order the signature allows, and the order ticket labels server estimates.

updates.title: Security policy covers the whole stack
updates.line: SECURITY.md now covers the website and operations, with accepted limits and review history.

updates.title: Stored data stays bounded
updates.line: Stored data now stays bounded: unused quotes, probes and idle anonymous keys are cleared.

updates.title: Credits are spent only on answers that succeed
updates.line: Call credits are now spent only on answers that succeed.

updates.title: The newest agent policy you signed wins
updates.line: Agent policies now carry a sequence, so the newest one you signed always applies.

updates.title: Dashboard keeps your session after reload
updates.line: Dashboard keeps your agents after a reload.

updates.title: Public usage counts
updates.line: Usage counts are now public.
